description: Core performance optimizations across the entire site. Fixes the highest-impact jank sources: unthrottled mousemove setState in page.tsx, eager audio loading in BackgroundMusic, SplashScreen rendering 300 frames at full devicePixelRatio, the ProjectMap WebGL Canvas always being fixed/fullscreen even when scrolled away, and missing dynamic imports for all heavy components. Also adds next.config.ts optimizations.
steps: 1. app/page.tsx — Replace the raw mousemove setState with a RAF-throttled version: use a rafId ref, only call setMousePos inside a requestAnimationFrame callback and cancel the pending frame before scheduling a new one. Also detect touch devices (window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)')) and skip attaching the mousemove listener entirely on mobile — the reveal effect is meaningless without a mouse.

2. app/page.tsx — Wrap the hero reveal layer (the div with maskImage) in a conditional: only render it when !isMobile (where isMobile is detected on mount via the pointer:coarse media query). On mobile show a static gradient overlay instead. This prevents a composited layer from existing at all on mobile.

3. app/layout.tsx — Wrap BackgroundMusic, AITerminal, and SplashWrapper in next/dynamic with ssr:false and loading:()=>null. These are purely client-side and currently block the main bundle. SplashWrapper already checks pathname, so dynamic import is safe. Example: const BackgroundMusic = dynamic(() => import('@/components/BackgroundMusic'), { ssr: false, loading: () => null })

4. components/BackgroundMusic.tsx — Change <audio preload='auto'> to preload='none'. The current preload='auto' causes the browser to download the ~weba audio file immediately on page load. With the interaction-listener approach already in the component, preload='none' is correct — audio will only load once the user interacts. The audio.play() call in the onInteraction handler will trigger lazy loading automatically.

5. components/SplashScreen.tsx — Cap devicePixelRatio to max 1.5 (currently the canvas resize uses no cap, so on a 3x Retina display it paints 9x the pixels). Change the resize() function to: const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 1.5). Also reduce the initial batch size from 35 to 20 frames before calling setReady(true) to show content faster.

6. components/ScrollSequence.tsx — The canvas already caps dpr at 2 (good). Add an IntersectionObserver to start/stop the RAF render loop: when the section is not intersecting, cancelAnimationFrame and pause. When it comes back into view, restart. This prevents 300fps canvas redraws while the user is reading the BentoGrid or ProjectMap sections. Add a ref isVisibleRef and pause/resume the raf loop accordingly.

7. components/ProjectMap.tsx — The ButterflyOverlay Canvas is rendered with position:fixed fullscreen (100vw x 100vh) and is ALWAYS mounted when inSection is true. The problem: it stays GPU-active even when the user scrolls past. Fix: use the existing inSection state (already driven by IntersectionObserver with threshold 0.02) to completely unmount the ButterflyOverlay Canvas when !inSection — which is already done. But also cap dpr on the Canvas: change dpr={[1, 2]} to dpr={[1, 1.5]}. Additionally, change the Canvas gl prop antialias from true to: antialias: typeof window !== 'undefined' && !window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches — disables antialias on mobile/touch devices where the GPU budget is tight.

8. components/ProjectMap.tsx — The proximity/reveal RAF loop runs every frame even when the butterfly is idle. Add a dirty-check: skip setRuns() and setLit() if nothing changed (already partially done with the 50ms flush throttle — confirm it exists, and if not add: only call setRuns/setLit when dirty is true AND now-lastFlush > 50).

9. app/game/page.tsx — The Canvas uses antialias:true unconditionally. Change to: gl={{ antialias: !('ontouchstart' in window || navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0), powerPreference: 'high-performance' }} — but since window is not available at module level, use a useMemo or useEffect to compute the gl object, or use: gl={{ antialias: false, powerPreference: 'high-performance' }} (antialias on a game canvas is rarely noticeable). Also add dpr={[1, 1.5]} to cap pixel density.

10. next.config.ts — Add image optimization config and compression: export a NextConfig with images: { formats: ['image/avif', 'image/webp'], minimumCacheTTL: 31536000 }. These settings tell Vercel's edge to serve avif/webp and cache images for a year, reducing repeated image downloads. Also ensure no unnecessary config options are set.

11. components/BentoGrid.tsx — The useTilt hook sets inline style.transform on every mousemove inside onMove. This is correct (no setState). However, the tilt is applied to every card. On mobile/touch devices, add touch event support: in the useTilt hook, also add onTouchStart/onTouchEnd that snap to neutral transform. No jank introduced since it's direct DOM manipulation.

12. app/globals.css — Audit will-change usage: currently 'will-change-transform' is on the text overlay in ScrollSequence (correct) and 'will-change-opacity' on the exit overlay (correct). Confirm the glass-popup tiers do NOT have will-change set (they don't — the transition is CSS transition not will-change). No changes needed here, but document that will-change is correctly scoped.

13. components/LogoCarousel.tsx — Currently uses CSS keyframe animation (animate-marquee-left/right). This is GPU-accelerated via transform. No changes needed for performance — this is already the optimal approach. Add will-change: transform to the animating div as an inline style to hint the browser.

findings: All 13 steps implemented. Key finding: layout.tsx is a Server Component — next/dynamic with ssr:false cannot be used directly in it. Solution: created components/ClientShell.tsx ('use client') which hosts the three dynamic imports and wraps children, then layout.tsx renders <ClientShell> instead. This pattern is idiomatic Next.js App Router. Build passes with exit code 0, zero TypeScript errors. ScrollSequence RAF loop now pauses via IntersectionObserver when not intersecting, preventing 60fps canvas redraws off-screen. SplashScreen dpr capped at 1.5 (saves ~44% pixels on 3x screens vs old cap of 2). ProjectMap ButterflyOverlay Canvas dpr capped at 1.5, antialias disabled on touch devices. Game Canvas antialias disabled and dpr capped. preload='none' on audio prevents eager download. willChange:transform added to LogoCarousel marquee div. next.config.ts now exports avif/webp formats and 1-year cache TTL for images. INTEGRATION VERIFIED (iteration 1): npm run build exit 0, zero TS errors. ClientShell.tsx correctly uses 'use client' + next/dynamic ssr:false for BackgroundMusic, AITerminal, SplashWrapper. layout.tsx is a proper Server Component importing ClientShell. LayoutProps<'/'> is a Next.js 16 generated type in .next/types/routes.d.ts (included via next-env.d.ts) — valid. preload='none' confirmed on audio element. ScrollSequence IntersectionObserver RAF pause confirmed. ButterflyOverlay correctly suppressed with !isMobile guard. All seam cross-checks passed.
